# Anarchy and Christianity

*[Jacques Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) · 1988*

A short essay in which [Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) argues that the Bible carries a constant critique of political power, and that non-violent anarchism is the political stance closest to the Christian faith.
